Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Lani Esha: 31-year-old woman, 158 cm (short), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: round full face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; broad low bridge, full lips; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
